description.value: Greystone Lodge is a boutique ski-in/ski-out accommodation at the base of Blackcomb Mountain in Whistler, BC, offering individually owned and styled one- and two-bedroom suites managed on-site by Acer Vacation Rentals. It is a practical summer mountain-biking base as well as a winter destination, with secure bike storage, a heated saltwater pool, two hot tubs, and free underground parking in a building of only 50 units. Whistler Village is roughly a 7–10 minute walk or a short bus ride away, putting restaurants and grocery stores well within reach.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website's About Us page explicitly lists 'Secure Bike Storage' as a lodge amenity, confirming secure overnight bike storage. On-site front-desk management by Acer Vacation Rentals is confirmed, but no website passage describes staff protocols specific to loaded touring bikes, e-bikes, or trailers, so that criterion remains null. Other amenities—coin-operated laundry, vending machine, free Wi-Fi at 100 Mbps+, nearby restaurants, and nearby grocery (Nester's Market)—are directly confirmed by the About Us and FAQ pages.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly bookable accommodation in Whistler with confirmed secure bike storage and multiple other cyclist-relevant amenities.
enrichment_extras.notes: The About Us page mentions 'Two EV Charging Stations on P2 - Fees Apply' — these appear to be car-size EV chargers, not e-bike chargers, so e-bike charging was left null. Some unit amenities (air conditioning, in-suite washer/dryer) vary by unit.

Secure overnight bike storage.detail: About Us page lists 'Secure Bike Storage' as an explicit lodge amenity

Laundry.detail: About Us page lists 'Coin-Operated Laundry' as a lodge amenity; confirmed in body text: 'There is a coin operated laundry facility in the building.'

Nearby evening food.detail: FAQ states 'There are several restaurants within walking distance to Greystone Lodge'; site includes a dedicated Whistler Restaurants page

Nearby grocery.detail: FAQ explicitly references grocery stores in Whistler and recommends Nester's Market for pre-order delivery to the lodge

Vending machines.detail: About Us page lists 'Vending Machine' as a lodge amenity; body text confirms 'a vending machine for quick snacks.'

wow_evidence: Secure Bike Storage as a lodge amenity... heated saltwater pool, two hot tubs
